observation: An ordinary Windows launch failed when it relied on agent-injected build-tool paths; customer data also needed an explicit isolation boundary.
cause: Runtime and build dependencies were mixed, while project identity and source/view configuration lived in reusable logic.
proposed_rule: Separate compiled runtime from explicit builds; validate local executable and server identities without permanent PATH changes. Isolate project models, history, assets and preview/commit/import/export state. Use consistent SQLite backup and preserve originals; a new project stays empty until its own model is reviewed.
limits: Scoped to drawing workspaces, not general Windows maintenance; another real customer PDF remains untested.
